# Trademark Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-01.

Relaticle, Inc. owns the Relaticle™ name and logo (the "Marks"), whether registered or not. The code's licenses govern the code: the [AGPL-3.0](../LICENSE) everywhere except `packages/Cloud`, which carries [its own license](../packages/Cloud/LICENSE). This policy governs the Marks only. It takes away none of the rights those licenses give you.

The goal is simple: when someone sees the Relaticle name, they should be able to trust it means software and services from us.

## You may, without asking

- Self-host Relaticle, modified or not, for yourself, your organization, and its affiliates, and call it Relaticle, including on a subdomain such as `crm.example.com` or `relaticle.example.com`.
- Refer to Relaticle truthfully in articles, reviews, tutorials, talks, and comparisons, and show unmodified screenshots of it there.
- Say your product or service works with Relaticle, including in ads, as long as nothing suggests we made or endorse it.
- Name an integration, plugin, or package "[Your name] for Relaticle", and use "relaticle" in its package id (for example `acme/relaticle-sync`). "Relaticle" must not be the first word of the display name, your own brand must be more prominent, and the listing must say it is not made or endorsed by Relaticle, Inc.
- Link to relaticle.com or to the official repository.
- Keep the name in the code. Namespaces, package names, and class names that contain "Relaticle" do not need to change.
- Name a free or cost-recovery user group, meetup, or online community "Relaticle [City] Users" or similar, if it says it is community-run.
- Make stickers or shirts with the Marks to give away for free at events.

## You need our written permission to

- Offer Relaticle, modified or not, to anyone outside your organization as a hosted, managed, or resold service under the Relaticle name or logo.
- Distribute a modified version of Relaticle under the Relaticle name or logo.
- Use the Marks, or anything confusingly similar to them, as or in the name of your company, product, service, domain, app store listing, or social media handle, beyond the integration naming above.
- Use the Marks in advertising in a way that suggests your offer comes from us or that we endorse it. That includes ad text or a display URL that uses "Relaticle" as your brand, and bidding on "Relaticle" for an ad that does not make clear the offer is not ours.
- Sell merchandise that carries the Marks.
- Register the Marks, or anything confusingly similar to them, as a trademark, domain name, or business name.

Confusingly similar names include misspellings and combinations such as "Relaticle Cloud", "RelaticleHQ", or "Relatikle".

## If you host or distribute Relaticle for others without our permission

The AGPL-3.0 lets you do this. The Marks stay behind:

1. Give your service or version your own name and logo.
2. Remove our logo, and remove "Relaticle" as a product name from the interface, the marketing pages, and outgoing emails.
3. Until Relaticle lets you change its product name through configuration, you may leave the name where unmodified Relaticle displays it on its own, such as in its emails. Your service name, domain, and logo must still be your own.
4. You may state the origin factually, including in the interface, for example: "Based on Relaticle, an open source CRM. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Relaticle, Inc."

Removing the Marks never means removing a legal notice. Keep every copyright notice, license notice, and author attribution, including any Appropriate Legal Notices under the AGPL-3.0. A notice such as "© Relaticle, Inc." or "Based on Relaticle" is not a use of the Marks under this policy.

## Not trademark terms, but worth knowing

- `packages/Cloud` is not under the AGPL-3.0. Leave it out of any production deployment unless you have an agreement with us. The official Docker image already ships without it.
- The marketing copy on relaticle.com lives in `packages/Cloud`, so it is not under the AGPL-3.0 either. Do not copy it.
- If you modify Relaticle and offer it over a network, section 13 of the AGPL-3.0 requires you to offer your users its source.

## Using the Marks

Write "Relaticle" with a capital R and do not alter it. Do not put ® next to it until we announce a registration. Logo files are in the brand kit at [relaticle.com/press](https://relaticle.com/press).

Any use of the Marks this policy allows, or that we approve in writing, benefits Relaticle, Inc. and gives you no rights in the Marks. We may revoke a written permission, object to a use that breaks this policy, and update this policy. The date at the top shows the current version.
